scope: Local emulator runtime control using the supplied Spectron APK with only the three destructive WebTop branches disabled
network_scope: The emulator had ordinary networking enabled. This control records qplay milestones but does not identify or validate a production endpoint.

inputs.emulator: Android API 36 x86_64 with ARM64 native translation

procedure.package_install: The previously installed test package was fully uninstalled because its certificate differed from the local diagnostic signing key. The supplied APK file was not modified.

observed.screen_state: The custom green Graal Classic menu remained visible with Edit Profile and Start.

interpretation: The safe command control removes the previously confirmed WebTop SIGSEGV and leaves the native process alive through the observed qplay connection milestones.
The control did not render a playable world during the observation window, so it isolates the crash but does not solve the remaining menu or game-entry behavior.
The qplay Connected log is a local runtime observation only. Network contact and live-service compatibility were not independently audited.
